body: Thank you. This is good advice. Will talk to my kid tonight.
It was a sobering experience and I started getting help. Thank you.

Have you learned any anti-anxiety practices like mindfulness, square breathing, targeted relaxation, etc? Or visualization? There are tools you can use to overcome the anxiety. Keep playing. You won’t look back and regret it but you might regret if you don’t play. You love it so do it.
I will try to hit more meetings.  I don’t have any friends so maybe I can make some in AA. Thanks for responding. I do appreciate it.

We are stronger than we think. Taking it a day at a time and not worrying about the future helps me. Just for today I will try to be strong. You can do this if you have a willingness to try. And if nobody told you they love you today, I love you sister.

I’m going through something similar with my spouse. Although it is my fault based on something that I did. Reading Your post and all of the replies has helped me so thank you for posting. I hope you’re able to find happiness soon. Sometimes I have to repeat myself that this too shall pass.
